dogecoin.text: 2/8 Back then, private key protected software wallets were the norm. I stored my #Dogecoin on my laptop which eventually failed, taking my coins with it. A hard lesson learned, security & backup are crucial in crypto. #CryptoSecurity

1/8 As someone with over 10yrs of experience in crypto space, I've learned that being early doesn't always mean being a millionaire. I mined 200k #Dogecoin in its early days but lost them all due to hardware failure & uncertainty. #CryptoLesson
